This is the example I needed, thank you. Now I can see it working: the pasta card has a title that would run on and on, a big paragraph of description, and a long multi-item note — and on the card they're neatly trimmed. The title cuts off after a couple of lines, the description after a few, and the long note fades out at the bottom rather than shoving everything else down the page. So one bookmark with a lot of text doesn't blow up the card or make the grid a mess — the cards stay tidy and the same size, which keeps the library scannable.

And the important part checks out: when I click through to **Edit bookmark**, the full untrimmed title, the complete description, and the whole note with all its items are right there, nothing lost — only the little card preview is shortened, exactly as you said. That's just what I'd want. Long content is handled well.
